finding: Sec.2 (l.155-157) attributes a biconditional to a one-directional lemma: '...and blochPauli_gap_pos (gapped if and only if the d-vector is nonzero)'. It matters because the paper is otherwise scrupulous here -- Sec.4 explicitly flags pt_symmetric_real_spectrum_iff as a 'sharp biconditional' and adds 'Both directions carry content' -- so a referee reading the Lean will notice the asymmetry. recommendation: Either (a) weaken the paper prose to 'gapped whenever the d-vector is nonzero', or (b) ship the one-line converse and restate blochPauli_gap_pos as an iff. In BOTH cases also fix the BlochBundle.lean docstring in the same pass, otherwise the same overclaim will re-enter the next bundle that lifts this module.
